question: Could you tell me the number of orders, average payment per order and customer lifespan in weeks of the 3 custumers with the highest average payment per order, where the lifespan is calculated by subtracting the earliest purchase date from the latest purchase date in days, dividing by seven, and if the result is less than seven days, setting it to 1.0?

prediction.sql:
WITH order_payment AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, o.order_id, SUM(p.payment_value) AS order_total
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
  GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.order_id
),
cust AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         COUNT(*) AS num_orders,
         AVG(order_total) AS avg_payment
  FROM order_payment
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
top3 AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM cust
  ORDER BY avg_payment DESC
  LIMIT 3
),
lifespan AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id,
         CASE WHEN julianday(MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) - julianday(MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) < 7
              THEN 1.0
              ELSE (julianday(MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) - julianday(MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp))) / 7.0
         END AS lifespan_weeks
  FROM orders o
  WHERE o.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM top3)
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT c.customer_id,
       c.num_orders,
       c.avg_payment,
       l.lifespan_weeks
FROM cust c
JOIN top3 t ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id
JOIN lifespan l ON c.customer_id = l.customer_id
ORDER BY c.avg_payment DESC;

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
WITH order_payment AS (
  SELECT o.customer_id, o.order_id, SUM(p.payment_value) AS order_payment
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_payments p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
  GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.order_id
),
customer_stats AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    COUNT(order_id) AS num_orders,
    AVG(order_payment) AS avg_payment,
    CASE
      WHEN (julianday(MAX(order_purchase_date)) - julianday(MIN(order_purchase_date))) < 7
      THEN 1.0
      ELSE (julianday(MAX(order_purchase_date)) - julianday(MIN(order_purchase_date))) / 7.0
    END AS lifespan_weeks
  FROM (
    SELECT o.customer_id, o.order_id, op.order_payment, o.order_purchase_timestamp AS order_purchase_date
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payment op ON o.order_id = op.order_id
  )
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  num_orders,
  avg_payment,
  lifespan_weeks
FROM customer_stats
ORDER BY avg_payment DESC
LIMIT 3;
